rounds.title: Tab bar baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK tab group: three triggers, the selected underline and the baseline, with hover, active and focus-visible on an unselected and a selected tab, plus disabled, sm, lg, primary, no divider, vertical and a panel. Both variants draw the focus ring in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, as the switch round does: light 5.48:1 against white (today mint 1.33:1, under the 3:1 line), dark unchanged 13.5:1. This follows mint-on-light rule a (Q99). Fixed numbers: underline ink 5.48:1 light, 13.5:1 dark; unselected label 4.74:1 light, 6.94:1 dark; hover label 10.37:1 light, 13.07:1 dark. The open question is the baseline under the bar.

a.note: Today: baseline --et-surface-border-solid at --et-tab-baseline-opacity 0.2. Light 250 on 255, 1.04:1; dark 31 on 23, 1.09:1. The bar edge nearly vanishes in both schemes.

b.note: Pick. Baseline at opacity 1, the plain border token: light 229, 1.26:1; dark 64, 1.73:1. The same --et-surface-border-solid as the tooltip pane border; the 5.48:1 ink underline still stands out clearly on top.
